widget.name: Vis Timeline
widget.description: Vis Timeline Mendix Pluggable Widget based on https://github.com/visjs/vis-timeline.

property.caption: Items
property.description: The list of objects rendered as items on the timeline.

property.caption: Item ID
property.description: Unique identifier of the item. Used to match selections, events and group references.

property.caption: Start
property.description: Start date of the item.

property.caption: End
property.description: End date of the item. Leave empty for box and point items.

property.caption: Item Group ID
property.description: Must match the Group ID of the group the item belongs to.

property.caption: Item Subgroup ID
property.description: Places the item in a subgroup, a stacked lane inside its group.

property.caption: Order value
property.description: Sorts items within a group, lowest first. Also usable as the group's Subgroup order field under the name orderValue.

property.caption: Content type
property.description: Attribute renders plain text, or HTML when XSS protection is disabled. Custom renders the widgets you drop below, so any Mendix widget can be used as an item template.

property.caption: Content
property.description: Label shown on the item.

property.caption: Content widgets
property.description: Rendered inside every item when Content type is Custom.

property.caption: Visible frame widgets
property.description: Rendered in the visible part of a range item, so the content stays readable when the item is scrolled partly out of view.

property.caption: Type
property.description: box, point, range or background. Falls back to the default item type when empty.

property.caption: Class name
property.description: CSS class names added to the item element.

property.caption: Style
property.description: Inline CSS applied to the item element, for example: color: white; background-color: red;

property.caption: Align
property.description: Alignment of the content inside the item: auto, center, left or right.

property.caption: Limit size
property.description: When false the item element is not clipped to the visible window. Needed for very wide range items with absolutely positioned content.

property.caption: Tooltip type
property.description: Choose between no tooltip, a text template, or any Mendix widgets as tooltip content.

property.caption: Tooltip text
property.description: Tooltip content shown when hovering the item.

property.caption: Tooltip widgets
property.description: Rendered inside the tooltip when Tooltip type is Custom.

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Overrides the timeline wide editability for this item. Ignored when Timeline settings override items is on.

property.caption: Editable: update time
property.description: Allows dragging this item horizontally.

property.caption: Editable: update group
property.description: Allows dragging this item to another group.

property.caption: Editable: remove
property.description: Allows deleting this item.

property.caption: Selectable
property.description: When false this item cannot be selected.

property.caption: Groups
property.description: Optional list of objects rendered as rows. Leave empty for an ungrouped timeline.

property.caption: Group ID
property.description: Unique identifier of the group. Items refer to it through Item Group ID.

property.caption: Nested groups
property.description: Self reference set pointing at the child groups of this group.

property.caption: Tree level
property.description: Nesting depth of the group, starting at 1 for root groups.

property.caption: Group content type
property.description: Attribute renders plain text, or HTML when XSS protection is disabled. Custom renders the widgets you drop below.

property.caption: Group content
property.description: Label shown in the group column.

property.caption: Group content widgets
property.description: Rendered inside every group label when Group content type is Custom.

property.caption: Group tooltip
property.description: Tooltip shown when hovering the group label.

property.caption: Group class name
property.description: CSS class names added to the group row.

property.caption: Group style
property.description: Inline CSS applied to the group row.

property.caption: Group visible
property.description: Hides the group row when false. Defaults to visible.

property.caption: Show nested groups
property.description: Whether this group starts expanded. Defaults to expanded.

property.caption: Order value
property.description: Numeric value the groups are sorted by when Group order is set to Order value.

property.caption: Group order
property.description: Sorting applied to the group rows.

property.caption: Subgroup order field
property.description: Name of the item field the subgroups of this group are sorted by, for example orderValue, start or content.

property.caption: Stack subgroups
property.description: Whether items inside the subgroups of this group are stacked.

property.caption: Subgroups
property.description: Optional list describing the subgroups, used to toggle their visibility.

property.caption: Subgroup: group ID
property.description: The Group ID this subgroup belongs to.

property.caption: Subgroup ID
property.description: Must match the Item Subgroup ID of the items in this subgroup.

property.caption: Subgroup visible
property.description: Hides all items of this subgroup when false.

property.caption: Show current time
property.description: Draws a vertical bar at the current time, updated every second.

property.caption: Current time
property.description: Overrides the browser clock, for example to follow server time.

property.caption: Markers
property.description: Optional list of draggable vertical time bars.

property.caption: Marker ID
property.description: Unique identifier of the marker. It is also added as a CSS class on the bar, so markers can be styled individually.

property.caption: Marker time
property.description: Position of the marker on the time axis.

property.caption: Marker tooltip
property.description: Tooltip shown when hovering the marker.

property.caption: Height
property.description: CSS height of the timeline, for example '400px'. Leave empty to size to the content.

property.caption: Minimum height
property.description: CSS minimum height, for example '200px'.

property.caption: Maximum height
property.description: CSS maximum height, for example '600px'. Combine with vertical scrolling.

property.caption: Width
property.description: CSS width of the timeline, for example '100%'.

property.caption: Auto resize
property.description: Automatically redraw when the container is resized.

property.caption: Axis orientation
property.description: Where the time axis is drawn.

property.caption: Item orientation
property.description: Whether items are aligned to the top or the bottom of their row.

property.caption: Content alignment
property.description: Default alignment of content inside items.

property.caption: Default item type
property.description: Item type used for items that do not specify one. Auto means box without an end date and range with one.

property.caption: Stack items
property.description: Move overlapping items so they do not cover each other.

property.caption: Stack subgroups
property.description: Stack the subgroups within each group.

property.caption: Group height mode
property.description: Auto sizes each group to its content, Fixed gives every group the same height, Fit items sizes to the visible items only.

property.caption: Margin: axis
property.description: Minimum distance in pixels between items and the time axis.

property.caption: Margin: item horizontal
property.description: Minimum horizontal distance in pixels between items.

property.caption: Margin: item vertical
property.description: Minimum vertical distance in pixels between items.

property.caption: Right to left
property.description: Render the timeline right to left.

property.caption: Show major labels
property.description: Show the upper row of the time axis.

property.caption: Show minor labels
property.description: Show the lower row of the time axis.

property.caption: Show week scale
property.description: Add a calendar week number scale to the time axis.

property.caption: Maximum minor label characters
property.description: Character width used to decide when the axis switches to a coarser scale.

property.caption: Show tooltips
property.description: Show the item tooltip on hover.

property.caption: Tooltip follows mouse
property.description: Move the tooltip along with the cursor instead of pinning it to the item.

property.caption: Tooltip overflow
property.description: How a tooltip that does not fit the window is repositioned.

property.caption: Tooltip delay
property.description: Delay in milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

property.caption: Tooltip while dragging
property.description: Show the item dates in a tooltip while the item is being dragged or resized.

property.caption: Window start
property.description: Start of the visible window. The window is moved whenever this value changes.

property.caption: Window end
property.description: End of the visible window. The window is moved whenever this value changes.

property.caption: Fit to items
property.description: When the visible window is adjusted to contain all items.

property.caption: Minimum date
property.description: The timeline cannot be moved before this date.

property.caption: Maximum date
property.description: The timeline cannot be moved beyond this date.

property.caption: Fixed scale
property.description: Forces a fixed scale on the time axis instead of adapting to the zoom level.

property.caption: Fixed scale step
property.description: Step size of the fixed scale, for example 5 with scale Minute.

property.caption: Minor label formats
property.description: JSON object with moment.js formats per scale, for example {"weekday":"ddd D","day":"D"}.

property.caption: Major label formats
property.description: JSON object with moment.js formats per scale, for example {"day":"MMMM YYYY"}.

property.caption: Locale
property.description: moment.js locale code, for example 'nl' or 'de'. Leave empty for English.

property.caption: Label for current
property.description: Overrides the word shown on the current time bar tooltip.

property.caption: Label for time
property.description: Overrides the word shown on custom time bar tooltips.

property.caption: Time zone offset
property.description: Renders all dates in a fixed offset instead of the browser time zone, for example '+05:30' or '-08:00'.

property.caption: Hidden periods
property.description: Optional list of periods that are cut out of the timeline, such as weekends or nights.

property.caption: Hidden period start
property.description: Start of the hidden period.

property.caption: Hidden period end
property.description: End of the hidden period.

property.caption: Hidden period repeat
property.description: Empty, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly.

property.caption: Rolling mode
property.description: Keep the current time in view and scroll the window along with it.

property.caption: Rolling mode offset
property.description: Horizontal position of the current time, from 0 (left) to 1 (right).

property.caption: Selectable
property.description: Allow items to be selected.

property.caption: Multi select
property.description: Allow selecting multiple items with ctrl or shift.

property.caption: Multi select per group
property.description: Restrict a multi selection to items in the same group.

property.caption: Sequential selection
property.description: Only allow selecting items that are adjacent in time.

property.caption: Long press time
property.description: Milliseconds a touch must be held before it counts as a selection.

property.caption: Selected item IDs
property.description: Two way bound, comma separated list of selected item IDs. Write to it to change the selection from a microflow.

property.caption: Focus on selection
property.description: Move the window to the selected items when the selection is set from Mendix.

property.caption: Moveable
property.description: Allow dragging the window.

property.caption: Zoomable
property.description: Allow zooming with the scroll wheel or pinch.

property.caption: Zoom key
property.description: Require this key to be held while scrolling in order to zoom.

property.caption: Zoom friction
property.description: Higher values make zooming slower.

property.caption: Minimum zoom interval
property.description: Smallest visible interval in milliseconds, for example 3600000 for one hour.

property.caption: Maximum zoom interval
property.description: Largest visible interval in milliseconds.

property.caption: Prefer zoom
property.description: Zoom instead of scroll when the wheel is used without the zoom key.

property.caption: Horizontal scroll
property.description: Move the window with the scroll wheel.

property.caption: Invert horizontal scroll
property.description: Invert the direction of horizontal scrolling.

property.caption: Vertical scroll
property.description: Scroll the groups vertically with the scroll wheel. Combine with a maximum height.

property.caption: Click to use
property.description: Only react to mouse and touch events after the timeline has been clicked once.

property.caption: Cluster items
property.description: Merge items that are close together into a single cluster when zoomed out.

property.caption: Cluster maximum items
property.description: Number of items shown before the rest is clustered.

property.caption: Cluster fit on double click
property.description: Zoom to the contents of a cluster when it is double clicked.

property.caption: Cluster show stripes
property.description: Draw a line from a cluster to the items it contains.

property.caption: Cluster title template
property.description: Label of a cluster. Use {count} for the number of clustered items.

property.caption: Allow add
property.description: Allow creating items by double clicking an empty spot.

property.caption: Allow remove
property.description: Show a delete button on selected items.

property.caption: Allow drag in time
property.description: Allow dragging and resizing items horizontally.

property.caption: Allow drag between groups
property.description: Allow dragging items to another group.

property.caption: Timeline settings override items
property.description: Ignore the per item editability attributes and use these timeline wide settings for every item.

property.caption: Items always draggable
property.description: Drag items without selecting them first.

property.caption: Ranges always resizable
property.description: Resize range items without selecting them first.

property.caption: Allow add group
property.description: Allow dragging an item onto the group area to create a group.

property.caption: Allow remove group
property.description: Allow removing groups.

property.caption: Allow reorder groups
property.description: Allow dragging groups to reorder them. Requires an Order value and Group order set to Order value.

property.caption: Apply snapping?
property.description: Snap dragged items to nice round values. Turn off for free positioning.

property.caption: Snap to minutes
property.description: Snap to a fixed number of minutes, for example 15. Leave at 0 to use the default snapping of vis-timeline.

property.caption: On add behaviour
property.description: Whether a newly drawn item is kept on screen, or discarded so it can be recreated by the On add action through the data source.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Discard and let the action create it
Keep on screen and call the action

property.caption: On move behaviour
property.description: Whether a moved item keeps its new position, or snaps back so it can be repositioned by the On move action through the data source.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Keep new position and call the action
Revert and let the action move it

property.caption: On remove behaviour
property.description: Whether a deleted item disappears immediately, or stays until the On remove action deletes it through the data source.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Keep and let the action delete it
Remove immediately and call the action

property.caption: On click
property.description: Triggered on every click on the timeline.

property.caption: On double click
property.description: Triggered when the timeline is double clicked.

property.caption: On context menu
property.description: Triggered on right click. The browser context menu is suppressed when this action is configured.

property.caption: On item hover
property.description: Triggered when the mouse enters an item.

property.caption: On item hover out
property.description: Triggered when the mouse leaves an item.

property.caption: On drop
property.description: Triggered when an external HTML5 drag and drop payload is dropped on the timeline.

property.caption: On select
property.description: Triggered when the selection changes by user interaction.

property.caption: On window changed
property.description: Triggered after the visible window has moved or zoomed.

property.caption: On initial draw complete
property.description: Triggered once, when the timeline has been drawn for the first time.

property.caption: On marker moving
property.description: Triggered continuously while a marker is dragged.

property.caption: On marker moved
property.description: Triggered when a marker has been dropped at its new time.

property.caption: On add
property.description: Triggered when the user draws a new item.

property.caption: On update
property.description: Triggered when an editable item is double clicked, so it can be edited on a page.

property.caption: On move
property.description: Triggered when an item has been dragged or resized to a new position.

property.caption: On moving
property.description: Triggered continuously while an item is being dragged. Use a nanoflow, this fires on every mouse move.

property.caption: On remove
property.description: Triggered when the user deletes an item.

property.caption: On add group
property.description: Triggered when a new group is created.

property.caption: On move group
property.description: Triggered when a group is moved.

property.caption: On remove group
property.description: Triggered when a group is removed.

property.caption: On group order swap
property.description: Triggered when two groups swap places by dragging. Persist both order values to make the new order stick.

property.caption: On group dragged
property.description: Triggered when a group has been dragged to a new place.

property.caption: Command
property.description: Write a command to this attribute to control the timeline from a microflow: fit, redraw, zoomIn, zoomOut, moveLeft, moveRight, toggleRollingMode, focus:<itemId>, moveTo:<ISO date>, setWindow:<ISO start>|<ISO end>. The widget clears the attribute once the command has run.

property.caption: Animate window changes
property.description: Animate window, focus and zoom changes triggered from Mendix.

property.caption: Animation duration
property.description: Duration of those animations in milliseconds.

property.caption: Animation easing
property.description: Easing function used for those animations.

property.caption: Data attributes
property.description: Copy item fields onto the item element as data- attributes. Use 'all' or a comma separated list such as 'id,start,end'.

property.caption: Disable XSS protection
property.description: Render item and group content as raw HTML. Only enable this when the content is trusted.

property.caption: Show loading overlay
property.description: Dim the timeline and show a spinner while the data sources are loading.

property.caption: Extra options (JSON)
property.description: JSON object merged into the vis-timeline options after all properties above, for any option that is not exposed as a property.
